name: Hibiya Rito
source:
"Nothing to be upset or cry for..."
"I'll make a new place for myself."

Heresy x Genuine

A taciturn, deliquent student who doesn't fit in at school. It seems he used to have a lot of conflict with former student council president, Sakuraba Touri. 
He had met with heroine since they were in middle school and considered as the only human friend he had. 

He is a senior in a third grade & shares same class as Kanda Ren. Has an impressive knowledge about biology to the point of making the teachers astonished.
